# English

Hello international football fan, welcome at Sparta Rotterdam!

Sparta Rotterdam is a Dutch professional football club based in Rotterdam. Established on 1 April 1888, Sparta Rotterdam is the oldest professional football team in the Netherlands. The club currently plays in the Eredivisie, which is the highest level of football competitions in the Netherlands.
